//: ¿El display_name distingue poste de apertura? Se reporta esqueleto enmascarado.
//ojo: Letras->a, digitos->9: se ve el formato, no los datos.

steps.eval: const findNode = (rx) => [...document.querySelectorAll('.x-tree-node-text')].find((el) => rx.test(el.textContent.trim())); const apps = findNode(/^aplicaciones$/i); if (apps) { let c = apps; for (let i = 0; i < 6 && c; i += 1) { if (c.querySelector && c.querySelector('.x-tree-expander')) break; c = c.parentElement; } const ex = c ? c.querySelector('.x-tree-expander') : null; (ex || apps).click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); } const mapa = findNode(/^mapas?$/i); if (!mapa) return { error: 'no Mapas' }; mapa.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10000)); return { ready: true };

const w = document.querySelector('#content').contentWindow; const req = (url, params, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => { let done = false; const finish = (v) => { if (!done) { done = true; resolve(v); } }; const timer = setTimeout(() => finish({ ok: false, e: 'timeout' }), ms || 10000); const fail = (e) => { clearTimeout(timer); finish({ ok: false, e: String((e && e.message) || e) }); }; try { w.Acs.request({ url, params, success: (r) => { clearTimeout(timer); finish({ ok: true, r }); }, failure: fail }); } catch (err) { fail(err); } }); const viewport = w.webMap_.getViewportParams ? w.webMap_.getViewportParams() : {}; const norm = (r) => { if (!r) return []; if (r.type === 'FeatureCollection') return r.features || []; if (r.type === 'Feature') return [r]; if (Array.isArray(r)) return r; return []; }; const mask = (s) => s.replace(/[A-Za-z]/g, 'a').replace(/\d/g, '9').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const out = {}; for (const code of ['F913184', 'F913122', 'F913124', 'F914012']) { const s = await req('svc_wmc.php', Object.assign({ action: 'textual_search', query: code, page: 1, start: 0, limit: 25 }, viewport)); if (!s.ok) { out[code] = { error: s.e }; continue; } const rows = Array.isArray(s.r) ? s.r : (s.r.rows || s.r.data || []); const ids = rows.map((x) => x.object_id).filter(Boolean); const gj = await req('svc_wmc.php', Object.assign({ action: 'get_objects_geojson', object_ids: w.Ext.encode(ids) }, viewport)); if (!gj.ok) { out[code] = { error: gj.e }; continue; } const feats = norm(gj.r); out[code] = feats.map((f) => { const d = (f.properties && f.properties.display_name) || ''; return { len: d.length, skeleton: mask(d), kw: { desconect: /desconect/i.test(d), fusible: /fusible/i.test(d), xs: /\bxs\b/i.test(d), apertura: /apertura/i.test(d), cuchilla: /cuchilla/i.test(d), reconect: /reconect/i.test(d), poste: /poste/i.test(d), remate: /remate/i.test(d), anclaje: /anclaje|derivaci/i.test(d), mt: /\bmt\b|media tension|media tensi/i.test(d) } }; }); } return out;
